Venue & Travel

Venue & Stay

Taj Mussoorie Foothills. Nestled in the Shivalik foothills of the Himalayas, we are calling it home for two days. We've booked your accommodation for both days of the wedding (Feb 26–27) — room allocation will be done at the property.

Travel

By air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant (~1 hour drive from the venue).

By train: Nearest railway station is Dehradun Railway Station (~30 min drive from the venue).

By road: ~4 hours by road from Delhi.

We'll take care of your transportation from the airport or railway station to the venue.

If you are flying into Delhi, please let us know so that we can help figure out the transportation.

FAQs

Please RSVP by 15th November so we can get an accurate headcount.

Please see our wardrobe planner to help you pick outfits.

Late February in the Shivalik foothills means mild, sunny afternoons but cold evenings.

A mix of both — some functions are indoors, others outdoors.

If you're coming all this way, why not stay a little longer? There are some beautiful places around Dehradun that are well worth exploring — Rishikesh, Mussoorie, and Landour are a few of our favourites.

And if you have a couple of extra days to spare, Delhi is always worth adding to the plan!

Need recommendations or a little help putting together an itinerary? We'd be happy to help. Just reach out to Raina (+91 9920086262) or Suryansh (+91 9871949294) and we'll send some ideas your way!

Reach out to Sagar (+91 9167191897) or Aashna (+91 9920801431) and we'll be happy to help.
